(Re-sending: the images did not arrive last time.) I built the glide from our confirmed list (v10). Attached: the same three boards - YOUR drawing left of the grey line, MY new render on the right (1: loop, 2: push-off, 3: landing).




Please check each item of our confirmed list against the pictures, strictly and literally. For each item reply MET or NOT MET; for NOT MET, describe exactly what you see in my render that is wrong and the precise correction. Do not repeat earlier mistakes: if you are not sure what you see, say so.

L1 three-quarter body, chest toward the viewer (not pure profile)

L2 Key low at the right hip, blade forward-down

L3 left arm trailing behind, elbow almost straight

L4 soft knees, feet behind/below, a few cm off the floor

L5 back 40-45 deg off vertical (I measure 42-45 deg on my render)

P1 drawing 1 dip; drawings 2-3 deep forward lunge, back leg pushing off

P2 Key raised behind the shoulder on drawings 2-3, forward-down on drawing 4

S1 landing drawings 1-2 wide low stance, torso nearly upright

S2 both hands on the Key from landing drawing 1, low in front, blade forward-down

F1 face looking toward screen right throughout
